summary: All 23 SRanger requirements are implemented in 9 Java files (one controller, 3 modes, 7 transitions). Nothing is unimplemented; the issues record design choices, two invented defaults, one ambiguity and the rounding of the fractional obstacleThreshold in the model.

issues.title: Moving -> Turning needs both the Obstacle event and the obstacleDetected guard
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 triggers the transition on the obstacle event; SR-GP1 says obstacleDetected (distance <= obstacleThreshold) is the guard on the same transition. Both are used: trigger Obstacle, condition obstacleDetected. An Obstacle event while the sensor reads above the threshold is ignored.
issues.fix_directive: If the obstacle event alone should suffice, drop '&& obstacleDetected' from the Moving branch and keep the predicate only if another transition needs it.

issues.title: Tick self-loops perform no action, so Moving's entry command is not re-issued on tick
issues.raw: SR-Beh4 and SR-Beh7 state that the controller performs no action on the tick self-transitions, whereas the profile asks every branch to perform the target mode's entry actions. The requirements were followed: the tick branches only re-assign the mode. Entry commands (SR-FR1/FR2/FR3) are issued inline on the branches that change mode.
issues.fix_directive: None unless the model's entry-action semantics require the self-loop to re-issue Move; in that case add the Move call to the tick branches and record the conflict with SR-Beh4/SR-Beh7.

issues.title: Priority in Turning: EndTask, then turnDurationElapsed, then Tick
issues.raw: The requirements give no priority between the Turning transitions. EndTask is a stop and comes first. The timed exit comes before the tick self-loop, because tick arrives every cycle and would otherwise prevent the timed exit from ever firing. The tick branch conjoins !turnDurationElapsed, as the profile requires for a branch below a guard-only branch.

issues.title: Power-up entry command Move(moveVel, 0) issued in the constructor
issues.raw: SR-FR1/SR-Beh1: Moving is entered at power-up and its entry issues Move(moveVel, 0). No step() branch represents the initial transition, so the constructor issues the command. The extracted model may not show this initial entry action.
issues.fix_directive: If the model must show the initial entry action, report it as a pipeline question: the profile has no branch for the initial transition.

issues.title: Move event carries two real components (lv, av)
issues.raw: SR-DM4 gives Move two real values. The profile describes events with one component; Move is a record with two @RoboChartType("real") components, lv and av, sent as actuator.apply(new OutputEvent.Move(lv, av)).
issues.fix_directive: If the extractor supports only single-component events, wrap the two velocities in a domain record and give Move a single component of that type.

issues.title: obstacleThreshold = 0.5 is fractional and is rounded up to 1 in the model
issues.raw: The constants interface rounds a fractional constant up to the next integer, so the model's guard reads distance() <= 1 instead of <= 0.5. The Java keeps 0.5. Only obstacleThreshold is affected; moveVel 1.0, turnVel 2.0 and turnDuration 2.0 are whole numbers.
issues.fix_directive: Treat verification results about obstacleDetected as an over-approximation (threshold 1 m in the model). No Java change proposed: the requirement fixes the value in metres.

issues.title: Obstacle threshold comparison: 'crosses below' vs 'at or below'
issues.raw: SR-DM3 and the system description say the obstacle event fires when the distance crosses below obstacleThreshold (strict); SR-GP1 defines obstacleDetected as distance <= obstacleThreshold. The guard uses <= as SR-GP1 states.
issues.fix_directive: None unless a strict comparison is intended.

issues.title: Sensor default distance 1000.0 m when no reading is available
issues.raw: SR-DM5 requires a 'large default value' without fixing it. distance() returns 1000.0 m until a reading arrives, and update() treats a negative or NaN reading as no reading (distance must be non-negative).
issues.fix_directive: Replace 1000.0 if a specific default is required.

issues.title: Actuator initial command (0.0, 0.0) and clockResetTime initial value 0.0
issues.raw: The Actuator stores (0.0, 0.0) before the first command (the constructor immediately overwrites it with Move(moveVel, 0)). clockResetTime starts at 0.0; it is read only in Turning, after Moving -> Turning has set it.

issues.title: Time source: Clock class with monotonic now(); controller field named timer
issues.raw: SR-Var1/SR-GP2 need the current time. A class named Clock provides now() in seconds since construction (System.nanoTime). The controller field is named timer because 'clock' is a reserved word. The clock reset is written clockResetTime = timer.now() before the Move command, in the order SR-Beh2 lists, and the guard as timer.now() - clockResetTime >= TURN_DURATION.

issues.title: Final ignores every input event
issues.raw: SR-FR3 makes Final terminal and no requirement gives it an outgoing transition or a tick self-loop, so its mode block is empty.
issues.fix_directive: None expected; a terminal mode lets time pass in RoboChart's semantics.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile, coverage, profile check, transformations, verifiers) and act on its reports.
